metaTitle: Custom Metal Golf Ball Markers | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom metal golf ball markers for your next tournament or corporate event. High-quality, durable, and perfect for branding.
introHtml: Metal golf ball markers offer a premium feel and lasting durability that plastic alternatives simply can't match. Whether you're outfitting a corporate golf tournament or creating giveaways for a sales incentive program, these markers hold up to repeated use while keeping your logo front and center. Choose from brushed steel, polished chrome, or matte black finishes to match your brand aesthetic. Customize with your logo using pad printing or laser engraving for a sharp, professional look that stands out on any green.
heroAltText: Custom metal golf ball markers with engraved logos, brushed steel finish, placed next to a golf ball on a putting green.
